intendedUse: Portrait photographs for the mobile practice place-selection cover flow. Image assets only.

images.name: Neighborhood café
images.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: full-bleed portrait photograph for a place-selection card in a mobile conversation practice app. This is the photograph only, not an app screenshot or a designed card.
Art direction: Beautiful, inviting editorial travel and interior photography with a natural analog feel, fine unobtrusive film grain, realistic material texture, rich but credible color, soft highlight roll-off and open detailed shadows. A composed yet believable everyday place the viewer can imagine stepping into. Architectural geometry must be convincing. No glossy real-estate HDR, no CGI, no illustration.
Composition: 3:4 portrait aspect ratio. Human eye-level viewpoint, roughly 35mm lens. A strong central scene that remains recognizable when cropped into a tall cover-flow carousel card. Clear foreground, middle ground and background for spatial depth, edge-to-edge photograph with no border. Thoughtful visual hierarchy, no chaotic clutter. Legible even as a small thumbnail.
Constraints: No people in the foreground, no prominent or identifiable people, no readable words, signs, lettering, logos, watermarks, typography, frames, UI or labels. Do not make a collage. A single photograph.
Scene: An inviting small neighborhood café on a quiet morning. Looking past the corner of a small round oak table and bentwood chair toward a recognizably real espresso counter with a brushed stainless-steel espresso machine, ceramic cups and simple shelves. Tall front windows send beautiful oblique sunlight across the wooden floor. Soft cream plaster walls, honey-colored oak, a modest forest-green tiled counter and one leafy plant. A ceramic cup on the foreground table gives human scale. Cozy and lived in, restrained contemporary café design, casual rather than luxury. The café counter is the main middle-ground subject and must be clearly visible. Warm morning light, natural off-whites and green, tasteful editorial composition.

Scene: A calm airport departure lounge in late-afternoon light, photographed from a traveler's eye-level viewpoint. A row of sculptural muted-blue terminal seats in the foreground and middle ground; beyond them enormous floor-to-ceiling glass windows frame a clearly recognizable commercial passenger airplane at its gate, with a jet bridge connected to the forward aircraft door. Neutral polished terrazzo floor, elegant repetitive steel window mullions, distant apron and a wide pale blue sky.
